rules.statement: An agreement to abide by the decision of a judge after inspection is valid under Section 428 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: "Tennekoon, J. held that inspection of a place by the judge is provided for in section 428 of the Civil Procedure Code, and as such, an agreement to abide by the decision of the Judge after inspection was valid in terms of this section."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: "inspection of premises is provided for in Section 428 of Civil Procedure Code"
